The fiber width ranges from 0.05 to 0.13 fiber width, the fiber length is very uniform and a very small SD. To aid in filamentization, the urethane sized fibers were subjected to an air blast after the fibers were cut and fell down from the cutters before they reached the conveying belt. The boxed in area below the cutters was fit with air poppets (jets) where compressed air could be dialed in for a certain velocity. In this work, air jets were mounted diagonally from one corner to the other at two ends.
